opportunities.name: Book-to-film research note
opportunities.description: For a given classic book title, find its top Project Gutenberg edition (author, download count), look up the film adaptation on IMDb (year, rating), and add a 'Unit:' note summarising both.
steps: Open gutenberg.org and type the book title into Quick search, click Go
Open the most-downloaded matching edition and note author and download count
Open imdb.com and search the same title
Pick the relevant film adaptation from results and note its year and IMDb rating
Open the Notes page and type 'Unit: <Title> by <Author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>' into New note and submit

instances.values: Frankenstein -> Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, 160188 downloads; Film 2025, 7.4
Pride and Prejudice -> Jane Austen, 192356 downloads; Film 2005, 7.8
Treasure Island -> Robert Louis Stevenson, 35366 downloads; Film 1990, 7.0

opportunities.name: Country geography profile note
opportunities.description: For a given country, read its capital, population, languages and currency from Wikipedia, look up the capital's current local time on timeanddate.com, and add a 'Geography:' note.
steps: Open Wikipedia and search the country name; open the country article
Read capital, population, official languages and currency from the infobox
Open timeanddate.com World Clock and search the capital city
Open the matching city result and read the current local time and timezone
Open Notes and add 'Geography: <Country>, capital <Capital>, pop <population>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time> <TZ>'

instances.values: Peru / Lima, pop 34,157,732, PEN, 12:55:16 PET (Allrecipes interruption in between)

opportunities.name: Viator museum ticket search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for admission tickets to a given museum, skip date selection, and open the top-listed ticket/tour result.
steps: Type '<Museum> tickets' into the Where to / search box
Choose 'Search for <Museum> tickets' (skip dates if the date picker appears)
Review results and click the first ticket/tour card
